EmailTemplate.description: Microsoft Teams message sharing a project document (meeting note) with the PMT team owners (Custom Teams Message PMTDocumentNotifyAllOwners). Rendered on the document's project (ProjectDocuments__c has no activities, so no template renders on it): the document's name, author, link and note come from the Flow as tokens {_DocumentName_}, {_DocumentAuthor_}, {_DocumentLink_}, {_DocumentNote_}.
EmailTemplate.name: PMT - Document Notify All Owners (Teams)
EmailTemplate.subject: PMT New Meeting note - {{{ProjectProduct__c.Name}}}
